digest.component_or_area: Plan-review criteria framework and reviewer prompts
propositions: The dual vocabulary 'success criteria' and 'acceptance criteria' in reviewer prompts causes ambiguity by suggesting a distinction the criteria do not implement, requiring consolidation to 'acceptance criteria' throughout
The criteria routing index and reviewer prompts contain 11 references to 'success criteria' vocabulary that must be renamed to 'acceptance criteria' across specified files and locations

The generated plan-review criteria guide must be regenerated from the renamed prompts to eliminate downstream 'success criteria' references while preserving deliberately excluded uses in T2 and verifier contexts

The routing index edit rotates the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding attestations, but is safe to proceed because the prerequisite ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) that grandfathers this has merged

Three in-scope 'success criteria' references must survive in excluded contexts: plan_review_T2.md generic English about trial metrics, and dod_uncertifiable wording in plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md
